condition.question: From verified stored numeric seeds and no observers, does the selected dynamic reader keep its seed, calculate once, or enter an iterative session? Its first read reaches a known selected cyclic A1 before the reader reveals its own D1 self-reference. Record each command separately. The Range and Rebuild conditions start in separate fresh processes from identical formulas/settings/seeds; neither answer is inferred from the other.

result.limitations: Pure COM lane, no observer UDF or event instrumentation. Save and reopen are separate recorded operations; initial stored seeds are verified before calculation.
